dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

highlights.title: Resident privileges applied correctly—and the booking completed
highlights.summary: A Palm Beach County resident requested a three-player, nine-hole tee time for 6 August. SpeakSport correctly recognized the caller’s FPC access and 14-day booking window, offered nearby availability and completed the reservation for 7:57 AM on Heron.
highlights.quote: “August 6 is exactly 14 days from today, so you’re eligible to book.” SpeakSport then offered nearby options and confirmed three players at 7:57 AM on the Heron course.

highlights.title: A single-player request converted with a helpful alternative
highlights.summary: When the caller’s requested 9:30 AM time did not have a group available, SpeakSport kept the conversation moving by offering the closest viable options. The caller selected 9:18 AM on Osprey and the booking was confirmed.
highlights.quote: “There’s one spot remaining at 9:18 AM on Osprey.” The caller accepted, and SpeakSport confirmed the 18-hole booking with a golf cart.

highlights.title: An out-of-window request was protected and routed correctly
highlights.summary: A caller requested a date beyond their seven-day booking window. SpeakSport explained the applicable limit, identified the furthest eligible date and transferred the caller to the golf shop when they asked to speak with a representative.
highlights.quote: “The furthest date I can book for you right now is Wednesday, July 29.” When the caller requested a representative, SpeakSport routed the call to the golf shop.

features_intro: We have continued strengthening the integrated experience around booking accuracy, reservation servicing and clearer operational insight.

features.title: Cancellations on call
features.description: Callers can now cancel eligible bookings through the same conversational experience, reducing another common reason for staff intervention.

features.title: Stronger booking-eligibility verification
features.description: SpeakSport now applies booking-window and account-eligibility checks more rigorously, helping prevent ineligible reservations while giving callers a clear next step.

features.title: Upcoming-booking confirmations
features.description: When callers ask about an upcoming tee time, SpeakSport can confirm the relevant booking details without requiring a staff handoff.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports deeper filtering by call intent, category and outcome, making it easier to understand demand and identify opportunities.

future_note: We plan to keep enriching SpeakSport for Okeeheelee Golf Course, including self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love for your team to help shape that journey by sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep rates, policies, facility information and caller guidance current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, eligibility, course preferences and caller outcomes.
